sentences.text: Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances  stated in the affidavit filed along with the WP(C) the High Court be  pleased to stay all further proceedings in AA No: 92/2022 field under Section 3G (5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 and direct the 4th  respondent to disburse the balance amount of compensation ordered in LAC  No: 138/2020 with all consequential benefits.
Provisionally, pending  disposal of the writ petition (Civil), in the interest of justice.

This petition again coming on for orders upon perusing the petition  and the affidavit filed in support of WP(C) and this Court's order dated  01-11-2024 and upon hearing the arguments of DEEPAK RAJ, GOUTHAMI, VIPIN  MATHEW OOMMAN Advocates for the petitioners and of DEPUTY SOLICITOR  GENERAL of INDIA for R1 and GOVERNMENT PLEADER for R2 to R4, the court  passed the following:
